facts.text: Pendry Newport Beach is a resort in coastal Orange County, California.
facts.excerpt:
A Newport Beach Resort

## Located in Coastal Orange County

facts.text: The beaches of Corona Del Mar and Crystal Cove are moments away from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: venture just moments away to the region’s most iconic beaches. From Corona Del Mar to Crystal Cove, explore a scenic stretch of surf, sand and style.

facts.text: The hotel is at 690 Newport Center Drive, Newport Beach.
facts.excerpt: 690 Newport Center Dr, Newport Beach, California 92660

facts.text: Many guestrooms and suites have ocean, bay and/or harbor views.
facts.excerpt: Many guestrooms feature ocean, bay and/or harbor views

facts.text: The suites have spacious interiors by Studio Munge.
facts.excerpt: 114 suites feature spacious interiors by Studio Munge

facts.text: All rooms have Exclusively Pendry bath products, Pendry signature bedding and curated mini bars.
facts.excerpt: all are adorned with Exclusively Pendry bath products, Pendry signature bedding, state-of-the-art technology, curated mini bars and more.

facts.text: Spa Pendry is a coastal-inspired spa that welcomes resort guests and locals.
facts.excerpt: Welcoming resort guests and locals alike to our coastal-inspired spa hideaway

facts.text: The 24/7 fitness center has Peloton and TechnoGym equipment.
facts.excerpt: 24/7 private fitness center, featuring state-of-the-art equipment, including Peloton, TechnoGym and more

facts.text: The resort has an outdoor pool with an expansive lounging deck.
facts.excerpt: sparkling outdoor pool with expansive lounging deck

facts.text: Tree Shack Pool Bar & Grill serves Baja-inspired snacks and poolside drinks in an al fresco setting.
facts.excerpt: Tree Shack epitomizes the best of Southern California in an Orange County resort setting with its expansive al fresco setting, lush landscape and casual menu of Baja-inspired snacks and poolside drinks

facts.text: SET Steak & Sushi pairs a classic steakhouse with a fresh sushi menu and local sustainable seafood.
facts.excerpt: modernizes the classic steakhouse experience with the accompaniments of a fresh sushi menu, local sustainable seafood

facts.text: The Elwood Club is the hotel's private members' club.
facts.excerpt: The Elwood Club, where our version of a private members’ club serves up a very special side of Newport.

facts.text: The Living Room at The Elwood Club has a fireplace and a golf simulator and is reserved for members.
facts.excerpt: With cozy lounge seating, a roaring fireplace and a golf simulator, this family-friendly setting is the go-to for game day, a night out or a social hour with your closest everyone. Reserved for The Elwood Club members.

facts.text: Bar Pendry has live music and DJs on weekends.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy live music and DJs on weekends

facts.text: In-room dining offers a 24-hour menu.
facts.excerpt: In-room dining offers a 24-hour menu

facts.text: Paintbox is a children's program with custom activities, events and arts and crafts tailored to age and interests.
facts.excerpt: Paintbox keeps your youngest travelers engaged and inspired all day with custom activities, events, arts & crafts and more, tailored to their age and personal interests

facts.text: Guests can take a private charter cruise along the coast to the secluded shores of Emerald Bay.
facts.excerpt: Set sail aboard a private charter and discover Newport Beach from a new perspective, cruising along the coast to the secluded shores of Emerald Bay.

facts.text: The hotel has more than 58,000 square feet of event space, including a grand ballroom, an al fresco Event Lawn and intimate Salons.
facts.excerpt: more than 58,000 square feet of signature spaces including a grand ballroom, beautiful al fresco private Event Lawn and intimate Salons

facts.text: Pendry partners with brands including Cadillac, Heidi Merrick and UPPAbaby to offer guests exclusive services and amenities.
facts.excerpt: Pendry is proud to partner with a curated selection of leading brands, including Cadillac, Heidi Merrick, UPPABaby and others, to offer exclusive services, amenities, activities and more to our guests

facts.text: Accessible rooms have roll-in showers and handrails.
facts.excerpt: accessible bathrooms with roll-in showers and handrails

facts.text: The hotel's neighborhood guide covers Orange County spots from Fashion Island to theme parks.
facts.excerpt: Orange County’s finest cultural attractions, coastal highlights and must-see destinations from Fashion Island to world-renowned theme parks

facts.text: The hotel calls Spa Pendry world-class.
facts.excerpt: Spa Pendry is a signature, world-class beauty and wellness haven

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2024.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2024
